input.markdown:
Three design decisions are recorded. **App implementation has not started.**

## Accepted

| Decision | Result |
| --- | --- |
| D51 · Edge margin | 8 dp on Home and in lessons |
| D52 · Submit | Keeps its own column, despite my recommendation |
| D53 · Field label | Placeholder only |

A line grows from **287 to 311 dp** — about 48 characters instead of 44. Lesson text keeps its 20 dp margin.

## Checked and still open

The wiki rebuilt and its link check passed. Typography and confidence-slider snapping remain unresolved.

nextSteps.label: Review the type scale
nextSteps.recommendation: Set the reading rhythm before refining the remaining controls.

results.recommendation: Recommended marker and reason render only for the authored action; reason is associated with the checkbox; all choices start unchecked
results.desktop: Report, table, diagram, unchecked next steps and Notes rendered without helper captions
results.narrow: 420 px viewport has no document horizontal overflow
results.selection: Keyboard and pointer selection support multiple actions without Notes; clearing them disables blank submission; failed saving preserves selections
results.retry: Save and submit errors preserve edits; retry succeeds; duplicate click does not resubmit
